what: Handoff detector ready to try on the Orin Nano with a webcam, no arm needed
why: Tonight only the Jetson and a webcam are available, so the detector has to be testable with them before it meets the real arms on Sunday.
details: Live mode adds a preview window, a session summary (latency p50/p95, detections per label, moments, actions) and recording to replay traces. Step-by-step Orin setup: offline tests, Ultralytics on JetPack 6, TensorRT export, act out the handoff. 28 offline tests pass; still untested on a real camera or real models.
